description: This source file defines React components and utility functions for displaying badges related to defect severity and status, as well as a date formatting function. It imports types for 'DefectStatus' and 'Severity' and exports three components/functions: SeverityBadge, StatusBadge, and formatDate.

methods.name: colorForSeverity
